from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
from rapidocr_onnxruntime import RapidOCR
ocr=RapidOCR()
im=Image.open('/workspace/text_01.png').convert('L')
print(im.size)
# crop x pixel ranges with margin
ranges={'word1':(30,1060),'word2':(1030,1260),'word3':(1230,2080),'flagbrace':(30,300),'rightend':(1900,2080)}
for name,(a,b) in ranges.items():
    crop=im.crop((a,0,b,im.height))
    # add white border
    from PIL import ImageOps
    crop=ImageOps.expand(crop,border=30,fill=255)
    res,_=ocr(np.array(crop.convert('RGB')))
    print(name,[r[1] for r in res] if res else None)
